report.title: Transfer larger than balance is not rejected
report.summary: The page failed to reject a transfer larger than the balance, allowing an invalid transaction to proceed.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the ParaBank website and navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
Attempt to transfer a large amount of money from one account to another, exceeding the balance in the source account.
report.expected: The page should reject the transfer and display an error message.
report.actual: The page allowed the transfer to proceed, exceeding the balance in the source account.
report.suspected_cause: The page's validation logic may be faulty, allowing invalid transactions to proceed.
report.next_action: Review the page's validation logic and ensure it correctly rejects transfers exceeding the balance in the source account.
